# Copilot instructions

This repository publishes the veyUI design skill. For UI design, redesign, polish or audit requests, read `skills/veyui/SKILL.md` and follow it. Resolve relative paths from that file.

Do not edit or commit `skills/veyui/foundation/` (fetched pinned upstream copy, hash-verified, git-ignored). See `AGENTS.md` for repository rules and the test commands.
